note: M9 (WP9.5b): a Sinumerik jump label whose name starts with N ('NEXT_PECK:') is a label like 'LAST_CUT:', not a block name: its block gets a number in front of the label, as the manual writes it (the label stands right after the block number). Before, the N of NEXT read as a block prefix and the line was skipped as a named block, while 'LAST_CUT:' was numbered.
